coordinated_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth, and using the toilet
Making and eating breakfast, boiling water with the kettle
Getting dressed and packing a bag for the workday
Commuting to the nonprofit office (walking/public transit)
Working as community program coordinator: planning events, coordinating with partner organizations, answering emails
Taking a lunch break near the office
Continuing program coordination work: writing reports, scheduling volunteers, preparing workshop materials
Washing dishes and cleaning up the kitchen counter
Using the computer to review tomorrow's program schedule and wind down
